title: Trader Diary: 86k BTC & My 10x Leverage
content:
Seen BTC at $86,094 and thought I’m a wizard.
Opened a 10x long, coffee in hand.
Price dips 0.5% → heart rate: 180 BPM.
Price rebounds → ego back to the moon.
lesson: Never let a 0.5% dip feel like a personal attack—set stop‑loss before the coffee wears off.
question: Who else turned a 10x coffee break into a cardio session today? 👀👇
